name: Sakurai Yozora
source:
"My name is Sakurai Yozora. I am Sakurai Maito's daughter who came from the future to save you, Kazuto-san."

The daughter of [url=/c9667]Sakurai Maito[/url]. Her hair color changes according to whoever Maito ended up with.

Birthday: "I'm a woman with lot of secrets"
Blood type: "I'll tell you in 10 years"
Hobbies: Star-gazing, window shopping
Affiliation: Sakurazaka Gakuen 2-B
Family: "There's my father and the rests are secret"
Subject forte: None
Part-time job: Coffee shop "Charlemagne"
Likes: All-you-can-eat, night sky during clear day
Dislikes: Cigarette smoke
Person she respects: The mother whom her father married to
Favorite place to go: Sakura hill
